title: Prefix of the leftward seek
statement: Let $W$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $a,R,n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $n\le R+1$, let $x$ be an input word over the schedule alphabet, and let $u\in\mathbb{Z}$. For a base configuration of the schedule machine on $x$, suppose its guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$. Starting in the leftward-seek phase with guide head at $0$, after $n$ steps the machine remains in the leftward-seek phase and its guide head is at $-n$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite binary Turing machine
$x$ is an input word over the schedule alphabet
the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$
